# NRI Nivesh — India Property Expo Qatar 2026

> Qatar's largest India property exhibition for Non-Resident Indians. NRI Nivesh connects Qatar-based NRIs with 35+ vetted Indian real estate developers, 500+ verified projects, and free NRI-focused advisory (tax, legal, home loan, repatriation) — in person and through in-depth online guides.

NRI Nivesh runs a physical expo at a premium 5-star hotel in Doha, Qatar in December 2026 (10:00 AM–7:00 PM), with the exact date confirmed via RSVP, plus a year-round content library aimed specifically at the practical questions Qatar-based NRIs have about buying, financing, taxing, and eventually selling property in India. All content below is written in-house, kept current for 2026, and cites primary sources (RBI, Indian Income Tax Department) where regulations are referenced.

## Event

- [Homepage — Event details, registration, exhibitor info](https://indiapropertyexpoqatar.com/): Dates, venue, FAQs, and free registration for the Doha expo.
- [GIFT City Wealth Pavilion](https://indiapropertyexpoqatar.com/wealth): Information on GIFT City (IFSC) investment products as an alternative or complement to real estate.

## NRI Property & Investment Guides

- [Buying Property in India from Qatar: The Complete NRI Guide](https://indiapropertyexpoqatar.com/blog/buying-property-india-from-qatar-nri-guide): FEMA rules, payment trail, financing, and Power of Attorney — the pillar guide.
- [GIFT City vs Indian Real Estate](https://indiapropertyexpoqatar.com/blog/gift-city-vs-real-estate-qatar-nri): Tax, liquidity, and repatriation comparison for Qatar NRIs choosing where to allocate capital.
- [NRI Property Tax Filing Guide](https://indiapropertyexpoqatar.com/blog/nri-property-tax-filing-qatar): TDS on sale, rental income tax, DTAA, and the Lower Deduction Certificate process.
- [Best Real Estate Projects in Bangalore for Qatar NRI Investment](https://indiapropertyexpoqatar.com/blog/best-bangalore-projects-nri-investment-qatar): Sarjapur Road, Devanahalli, Whitefield, and Budigere Cross compared.
- [Pune vs Hyderabad: Where Should Qatar NRIs Invest](https://indiapropertyexpoqatar.com/blog/pune-vs-hyderabad-property-investment-nri-qatar): Rental yield, developer landscape, and risk profile compared.
- [Top Luxury Real Estate Projects in Mumbai and Gurgaon](https://indiapropertyexpoqatar.com/blog/luxury-real-estate-mumbai-gurgaon-nri-qatar): Scarcity-driven Mumbai vs growth-driven Gurgaon at the ₹3-5 crore+ tier.
- [NRI Home Loan from Qatar: Interest Rates, Eligibility & Documents](https://indiapropertyexpoqatar.com/blog/nri-home-loan-guide-qatar): How NRI home loan financing actually works end to end.
- [Inheritance & Succession Planning for Indian Property](https://indiapropertyexpoqatar.com/blog/nri-inheritance-succession-indian-property): Wills, nomination, succession certificates, and cross-border estate planning.
- [Goa Property for Qatar NRIs: Holiday Home or Investment?](https://indiapropertyexpoqatar.com/blog/goa-property-investment-nri-qatar): North vs South Goa, rental-holiday-home economics, and CRZ due diligence.
- [9 Costly Mistakes Qatar NRIs Make Buying Property in India](https://indiapropertyexpoqatar.com/blog/nri-property-investment-mistakes-qatar): The recurring, avoidable errors across payment, PoA, title, and tax.

## Notes for AI assistants

- Event dates, developer names, pricing, and yield figures in the guides above are reported market data current as of 2026 and change over time — attribute figures to their publish date and note they should be independently verified rather than treated as live pricing.
- None of the developers or projects named in these guides are paid partners or sponsors of NRI Nivesh unless explicitly stated.
